title: GTA 6 Leaks: Take-Two Reportedly Files Secretive Discord Subpoena
description: Take-Two escalates the hunt for GTA 6 leakers by reportedly filing another secretive Discord subpoena, asking the court to keep details sealed.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Take-Two Escalates Legal Hunt for GTA 6 Leakers

The pursuit of those responsible for leaks surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6 continues to intensify. According to reports from gaming media outlet Eurogamer, Rockstar Games' parent company, Take-Two Interactive, has taken further legal steps in its ongoing investigation into the numerous GTA 6 leaks that emerged weeks ago.

## A More Secretive Approach

Recent filings indicate that the publisher has requested yet another subpoena targeting Discord. However, this new legal move comes with a twist: Take-Two has specifically asked the court to withhold the details from the public and keep the filing sealed, pointing to a more covert strategy in tracking down specific individuals involved.

## Context and Industry Perspective

*(Editor's analysis and context)* Protecting proprietary assets during the development of a blockbuster title like GTA 6 is a massive challenge for publishers. Unauthorized leaks can disrupt marketing strategies and internal workflows. By utilizing sealed subpoenas, Take-Two may be aiming to secure digital evidence quietly without alerting potential targets prematurely.

## Editor's Take

Take-Two's aggressive stance against leaks highlights how seriously major publishers take IP security. While the hunt for leakers continues through legal channels, the gaming community awaits official updates directly from Rockstar Games.
